id: \rDon't let my husband worry you. He wouldn't steal from anyone now. In fact, take this.
en: \rDon't let my husband worry you. He wouldn't steal from anyone now. In fact, take this.
it: \rNon preoccuparti per mio marito. Ormai non ruberebbe più a nessuno. Anzi, prendi questo.

id: \rHaha, don't worry. We bought that with hard earned money.
en: \rHaha, don't worry. We bought that with hard earned money.
it: \rAhah, tranquillo. L'abbiamo comprato con soldi guadagnati onestamente.

id: \rEvery time I step outside there is water! I can never get away from it. If only I had more money...
en: \rEvery time I step outside there is water! I can never get away from it. If only I had more money...
it: \rOgni volta che metto piede fuori c'è acqua! Non riesco mai a liberarmene. Se solo avessi più soldi...

id: \bI used to work for Team Rocket. I doubt you've ever heard of them. I'm glad I got out. The boss was always wanting more.
en: \bI used to work for Team Rocket. I doubt you've ever heard of them. I'm glad I got out. The boss was always wanting more.
it: \bUna volta lavoravo per il Team Rocket. Dubito che tu ne abbia mai sentito parlare. Sono contento di esserne uscito. Il capo voleva sempre di più.

id: \bThe rainwater here washes down to the bottom. I'm glad I could afford to live above the hill.
en: \bThe rainwater here washes down to the bottom.  I'm glad I could afford to live above the hill.
it: \bL'acqua piovana qui scorre fino in fondo.  Sono contento di essermi potuto permettere una casa in cima alla collina.
